rows.text: Ministry of Home Affairs notification No. 10/1/97-M&G(i) of 29 April 1997: the President has been pleased to accept the resignation of Shri H. D. Deve Gowda of his office of Prime Minister, and of the listed members of the Council of Ministers, with effect from 21 April 1997.

locator.item: Notification No. 10/1/97-M&G(i), New Delhi, the 29th April, 1997

rows.text: Notification No. 10/1/97-M&G(ii) of 29 April 1997: the President has been pleased to appoint Shri I. K. Gujral to be the Prime Minister with effect from 10.00 hours of 21 April 1997; the next paragraph appoints the members of the Council of Ministers, on his advice, from the same time.

locator.item: Notification No. 10/1/97-M&G (II), New Delhi, the 29th April, 1997
